phase: Issue #154 Phase 2-C2.6-B2-C2B2A: E1 P1 top-32 reservation contexts searched at the common L2 extent (post-hoc analysis)

intentionalStop.reason: The project owner closed the Phase as B2C2B2A_INCOMPLETE: the 44 tasks already run (t00 all 32 contexts: 25 completed, 5 timeouts, 2 out-of-memory; t01 ranks 1..12: 10 completed, 2 timeouts) gave sufficient negative evidence on the resource feasibility of applying the common L2 extent to every E1 Target; finishing all 352 tasks was not required. No condition was changed, no task was retried.
intentionalStop.boundary: after the outcome line of t01-r12 (the running child ended by itself first); the parent runner was killed before it started another child

reconstruction.launch: node scripts/run-planner-global-phase2c26b2c2b2a.mjs --export <Export> --targets <manifest> --run-dir .local/c2b2a-formal.run --output .local/PLANNER_GLOBAL_PHASE2C26B2C2B2A_RAW.json.local (no --allow-uncommitted / smoke option), detached process from a clean working tree at the measured HEAD
reconstruction.environmentRecomputed: host / Node / module constants recomputed at reconstruction; benchmarkCodeSha256 from the measured HEAD git objects by the runner rule

environment.runtime: Node (Vite SSR loader, one fresh child process per task, NOT a Browser Worker)

conditions.population: B2-C2B1 cohort E1 (extentInsufficient AND k1Minimal; oracle-guided population, declared), cross-checked with the B2-C1 subgroups: Target IDs only reach the Search runner
conditions.contextSelection: per Target the P1 ranks 1..32 of the schedule re-derived from the Export (derivePhase2C26B2C1Schedule(), Production default extent); no oracle compatibility, firstCompatible, required extent or ladder rung is read
conditions.extentRule: the unchanged reconstructPhase2C26B2B2AContext() at the default extent, then phase2c26b2c2b2aL2Context(): the extent alone replaced by the common L2 extent (B2-C2B1 ladder rung L2), every other field checked identical, the Search input digest recomputed by the unchanged phase2c26b1SearchInputDigest()
searchChildKnows: reservation digest / group / representative alias (re-derived and checked)
searchChildNeverKnows: whether L1 already covers the Target
conditions.limitation: E1, P1 and the L2 extent were chosen with post-hoc oracle evidence (B2-C1 / B2-C2B1). This measures only how far, on this Export and this population, searching the P1 top-32 contexts at one common L2 extent without oracle context selection rediscovers the exact oracle Route. It is not evidence that P1, a budget of 32, L2 or any capture policy is right for Production or for another Export.

runtimeComparison.note: Diagnostic only, never a decision input or a Production judgement. Different populations (B2-C2A: 20 default-extent Targets x P1 1..16; B2-C2B2A: 11 E1 Targets x P1 1..32) and different concurrency (3 vs 1) - process wall time is not directly comparable.

order: B2C2B2A_INVALID: a B2-C2B1 / B2-C1 / B2-B1 authority mismatch, an E1 population or Target manifest mismatch, a Target count other than 11, a task count other than 352, a P1 definition drift, a P1 schedule parity mismatch, a context rank duplicated / missing, a reservation digest / origin drift, a task or record extent other than the common L2 extent (a Target-specific extent included), a default / L2 Search input digest drift, an oracle / hash-chain / Export / CalculationContext / RNG mismatch, a recomputed P1 first compatible rank other than B2-C1's, a context mismatch in a Search child, a task outside the manifest or run twice, a Candidate reservation violation (sentinel included), an exact or partial Candidate (or an exact / partial sentinel) from a reservation-incompatible context, a first exact rank before the first compatible rank, a nonmonotonic Candidate cost sequence, a provenance failure, or a raw / result inconsistency
B2C2B2A_INCOMPLETE: no invalid reason, and a task was not measured (timeout / out of memory / process failure / notRun after an intentional stop: never Candidate 0, never retried in this Phase)
B2C2B2A_ALL_C8: all 352 tasks measured and C8 reaches an exact Candidate for 11 / 11 E1 Targets within P1 rank <= 32
B2C2B2A_ALL_C4C: all measured, C32 < 11, C4C 11 / 11 (a safety-capped capture still counts its exact Candidates: they lie inside the first four cohorts)
B2C2B2A_INCOMPLETE: all measured, C4C < 11, and a Target without a C4C exact has a safety-capped compatible context in its 32 (its C4C failure is undetermined)
B2C2B2A_PARTIAL: all measured, no invalid reason, C4C < 11 and every missing Target fully determined (0 / 11 is registered here too and flagged)
decisionRule.policies: C8 / C32 = the first 8 / 32 Candidates of the one C4C capture; C4C = every captured Candidate (up to four complete operation-cost cohorts; the sentinel never counts). C8 ⊆ C32 ⊆ C4C
decisionRule.exact: phase2c26b2c2aCompareContext() -> phase2c26b2b2aCompare() -> phase2c2OracleCoverage() per Candidate; partial_comparable is recorded and never counted as exact
decisionRule.firstExact: per Target and policy the smallest P1 rank whose context holds an exact Candidate in that policy; every rank 1..32 was searched regardless. first exact rank > first compatible rank is a legal measurement
decisionRule.compatible: phase2c26b2c2aReach() (phase2c26b2c1TargetReach() -> phase2c26b2aReachability()) over the re-derived schedule; must reproduce the B2-C1 P1 first compatible ranks
decisionRule.extent: every task and every Search at the common L2 extent { maxNormalAdvance: 128, maxGogmaAdvance: 235, maxSkillAdvance: 1500 }; the schedule / reservation universe / P1 ordering stay at the Production default extent

decision.recommendation: timeout / OOM / safety capを先に扱う（timeout taskの長時間再測定、extentによるresource explosion調査、Search runtime最適化のいずれかをレビュー後に決める）
